'''Eduardo Gudynas Silinskas''' (born 1960 in Montevideo) is a Uruguayan biologist and author specializing in environmental issues.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://columnistas.montevideo.com.uy/categoria_40_1_1.html |title=About Eduardo Gudynas |website=Montevideo.com.uy |location=[[Uruguay]] |accessdate=4 May 2023 |language=es }}</ref>

He is a member of the [[Latin American Center for Social Ecology]] (CLAES).<ref>{{cite web |url=http://ambiental.net/sobre-claes/ |title=CLAES |accessdate=4 May 2023 |website=Ambiental.net |language=es }}</ref> He works as an associate researcher at the [[University of California, Davis]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://revistaerrata.gov.co/autor/eduardo-gudynas |title=Author Eduardo Gudynas |accessdate=4 May 2023 |website=Revista Errata |language=es }}</ref> In 2016 he was the first Latin American person to obtain the Arne Næss Chair in Global Justice and the Environment from the [[University of Oslo]]; previous holders of the chair include [[James Lovelock]], [[David Sloan Wilson]] and [[Ramachandra Guha]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.sum.uio.no/english/research/networks/arne-naess-programme/arne-naess-chair/ |title=Arne Næss Chair |access-date=4 May 2023 }}</ref>

== Selected works ==
* ''Muy lejos está cerca''. Lima: RedGE, 2022.
* ''Extractivisms: Politics, Economy and Ecology'''. Fernwood Publishing, 2021. ISBN 978-1773631769.
* ''Derechos y violencia en los extractivismos. Extrahecciones en Bolivia y América Latina'' (with O. Campanini and M. Gandarillas). Cochabamba: La Libre, 2020.
* ''Ciudadanía en movimiento: participación en conflictos ambientales'' (with Alain Santandreu). Montevideo: Ediciones trilce, 1998. ISBN 978-9974321991.
